presets.name: High Dividend Stocks

presets.name: Blue Chip Stocks
presets.description: Spot blue-chip stocks from well-established companies for reliable returns and low volatility.

presets.name: Warren Buffett Strategy
presets.description: Spot stocks with strong earnings, growth potential, and recognized value for strategic long-term investment.

presets.name: Undervalued Stocks
presets.description: Spot stable, undervalued stocks for long-term growth.

presets.name: Best Growth Stocks
presets.description: Spot stocks with growth potential and solid financial standing.

presets.name: P/B Ratio Less Than 1
presets.description: Spot stocks with a price-to-book ratio (P/B) below 1. A lower P/B may indicate an undervaluation and a margin of safety.

presets.name: Best Long Term High Dividend Stocks
presets.description: Spot stocks with reliable dividends and steady growth for secure long-term returns.

presets.name: High P/E Ratio Stocks
presets.description: Spot stocks with high P/E ratios, which suggest a profitable and sustainable business.

presets.name: Good P/E Ratio Stocks
presets.description: Spot stocks with solid fundamentals and high P/E ratios for consistent profitability and returns.

presets.name: Low P/E Ratio Stocks
presets.description: Spot stocks with low P/E ratios, which are potentially undervalued for stable gains and reduced risk.

presets.name: Below 30 RSI Stocks
presets.description: Spot stocks with an RSI value under 30, which may indicate a rebound from negative market sentiment.

presets.name: Junk Stocks
presets.description: Spot small, high-risk, yet undervalued stocks with the potential for significant returns.

presets.name: Small Cap Stocks with Huge Growth Potential
presets.description: Spot small-cap stocks with significant growth potential.

presets.name: Blue Chip Dividend Stocks
presets.description: Spot familiar blue-chip stocks with high dividends for dependable income and value investment.

presets.name: Speculative Stocks
presets.description: Spot high-risk, high-return stocks, including those at their recent 10-day low that may be undervalued and ready to rebound.

presets.name: High Return On Equity Stocks
presets.description: Spot high-quality stocks with solid profitability, growth, and attractive dividends for long-term stability.

presets.name: Low P/E High Dividend Stocks
presets.description: Spot financially stable, consistently growing stocks for secure and steady long-term returns.

presets.name: Undervalued Semiconductor Stocks
presets.description: Spot semiconductor sector stocks that are well-valued, financially robust, and profitable for attractive long-term returns.

presets.name: Undervalued Tech Stocks
presets.description: Spot tech stocks that are undervalued by the market.

presets.name: Undervalued Bank Stocks
presets.description: Spot bank stocks that are financially sound, reasonably valued, and highly profitable.

presets.name: High EPS Stocks
presets.description: Spot stocks with favorable financial footing and high profitability for investment.
